messages:
Sam (oncall): noticing rapid controller-manager leader flips in eu-central after a brief network blip, GPUs autoscaler spun up extra nodes
Priya (SRE): alerts show etcd apply latency spikes ~700ms at 08:42 UTC, leader election frequency increased
Tom (network): we had a transit peer flap, routes moved off the primary path for ~90s
Lina (k8s): controller-manager logs show repeated lease reacquire cycles (lost -> acquired every 4s) causing controllers to restart reconciles
Sam (oncall): ScaleBot triggered 3 scale ups in 2 minutes, added ~4 GPU instances. Pausing autoscale now
ScaleBot: autoscale paused for eu-central-gpu by Sam at 08:44 UTC
Priya (SRE): mitigation: keep autoscale paused, manually set expected replicas to baseline, and add alert that correlates leader-election churn + etcd latency before allowing autoscale actions
Tom (network): peering team applied a fix and BGP converged at 08:44:30 UTC
Lina (k8s): propose increasing leader lease to 30s and renewDeadline to 10s to avoid churn during short network blips; will open PR and test in staging
Sam (oncall): file cost impact: approx $900 for the extra nodes during the 2-minute window, sending note to finance
Priya (SRE): filing runbook update and the new alert now
